name: Release 0.9.82
body:
* security: create `~/.config/firejail` to prevent sandbox escape (#7154)
  * security: fix use of dangling pointer for netns argument (#7246)
  * feature: allow subpaths in xdg macros (#2359 #7151)
  * feature: add `${PROJECTS}` macro (#7157)
  * feature: add `${PUBLICSHARE}` and `${TEMPLATES}` macros (#7164)
  * feature: profstats: add --include command line option (#7265)
  * feature: implement `syscall:log` in seccomp lists (#7289)
  * modif: create a new syscall group: `@program-keep` (9d90daf)
  * modif: stop following symlinks to /dev/null on disable (#5803 #7129)
  * modif: add backtick in `reject_meta_chars()` (#7183)
  * modif: add more metachars in `reject_meta_chars()` (#7186)
  * modif: fbwrap: improve log messages (#7227)
  * modif: add fchroot syscall (928e6ff 541dd07)
  * modif: move hardcoded blacklist ~/.config/firejail into disable-common
    (#7132 #7282)
  * modif/removal: X11 code restructuring:
    --x11=xpra support was removed.
    --x11=xorg support (Xorg security extension) was disabled in the default
    software configuration, the user will need to add --enable-x11-legacy flag
    for ./configure (./configure --enable-x11-legacy)
    --x11=xvfb support (xvfb display server) is disabled in the default software
    configuration, the user will need to add --enable-x11-legacy flag for
    ./configure (./configure --enable-x11-legacy)
    --x11=xephyr command is removed, however, Xephyr display server is used by
    default by --x11 command.
  * removal: temporarily disabled --ip=dhcp. ISC-DHCP is no longer supported
     in Debian. We will bring back this option in release 0.9.84 using
     a different DHCP client
     (https://tracker.debian.org/news/1782808/removed-443-p1-8-from-unstable/)
  * removal: --bandwidth= command (#7197)
  * removal: --tracelog/blacklist-nolog commands (#7198)
  * removal: ./configure --enable-busybox-workaround option (#7199)
  * removal: --private-home command (#7200)
  * removal: ./configure --disable-sandbox-check option (#7201)
  * removal: --x11=xpra option (#7207)
  * removal: firecfg --guide; the pertinent information was moved in
    man firejail (#7260)
  * removal: private-lib (#7261)
  * removal: ssh restricted shell feature (#7262)
  * bugfix: disable /run/systemd/resolve with net=none - fixes potential DNS
    leaks when using systemd-resolved (#7209 #7216)
  * bugfix: fbwrap: wait for target and propagate exit code (#7081 #7224)
  * bugfix: mountinfo: handle lines longer than 4096 bytes (#6450 #7225)
  * bugfix: fix string lifetimes in profile.c (#7267)
  * bugfix: fix ignored negation for syscalls number 0 (#7255 #7280)
  * bugfix: fix non-standard /etc/hosts lines (#6210 #7281)
  * docs: man: fix typo in example (#7106)
  * docs: recommend .deb or building from source on debian/ubuntu (#7110)
  * docs: note how to use net=none for appimages (#7257)
  * docs: firecfg: note to not enable devtools (#7276)
  * build: fix empty lists in syscall.c breaking compilation (#7108 #7109)
  * build: remove unused install.sh (#7124)
  * build: merge fnettrace headers into `fnettrace_common.h` (#7127)
  * build: remove unused `remove_cnt` variable in src/fsec-optimize/optimizer.c
    (156593d)
  * build: gen-syscalls.sh: remove trailing spaces in `new_syscalls.txt`
    (4a5ed83)
  * build: deb: add conflict with firejail-profiles (#7141)
  * build: netfilter.c: replace `system()` with `execv()` (#7159)
  * build: remove etc-fixes directory (#7148)
  * build: fix scan-build warnings (#7205)
  * build: disable --chroot= by default (#7202)
  * build: simplify and improve test-compile (#7206)
  * build: test: fix cleaning of some temporary files (#7222)
  * build: test: format/improve targets (#7223)
  * build: test: sync `DISTFILES_TEST` with `TESTS` (#7238)
  * build: disable --x11=(xorg|xvfb) options by default (#7263)
  * build: disable --ip=dhcp by default (#7264)
  * test: fix unescaped newlines in error messages (#7146)
  * test/fs: improve tests related to macros (#7147)
  * test/fs: deduplicate xdg dirs in macro tests (#7163)
  * test/fs: support and use XDG user dir env vars (#7167)
  * test/apps: full rewrite; currently make test-apps command test runs tests
    on about 70 common Linux applications; the test is targeted to Arch
    and/or Fedora platforms.
  * ci: make all main make steps parallel and sync output (#7162)
  * ci: dependabot: split and group codeql actions to fix checks (#7192)
  * ci: update clang-14 to clang-18 (#7203)
  * ci: build: replace ubuntu-22.04 with ubuntu-latest (#7210)
  * profiles: disable-programs: add lact paths (#7083)
  * profiles: disable-exec: add mount paths (#7112)
  * profiles: mumble: include whitelist-runuser-common (#7084)
  * profiles: disable-common: add xfce clipman path (#7120)
  * profiles: steam: allow ~/.cache/nvidia to improve game performance (#7114)
  * profiles: firefox-common: allow auto light/dark theme switching (#7103)
  * profiles: steam: allow more 3d cache paths (#7149)
  * profiles: torbrowser-launcher: add no3d (#7143)
  * profiles: add llm-agent-common.profile (#7158)
  * profiles: use xdg macros with subpaths (#7160)
  * profiles: man: add terminfo (#7130 #7131)
  * profiles: lutris: fix proton compatibility (#7181)
  * profiles: add allow-bwrap to profile.template (3725c08 1cd47bf)
  * profiles: templates: improve formatting & clarify rules (#7172)
  * profiles: disable-common: allow `${PATH}/dpkg` (6c0ec7c e694324)
  * profiles: firefox-common: add seccomp.block-secondary (#7204)
  * profiles: llm-agent-common: disable private-cache (#7212)
  * profiles: librewolf: add ~/.config/librewolf (#7233)
  * profiles: keepassxc: add ~/.local/state/keepassxc (#7235)
  * profiles: mpv: allow dbus mpris (#7134 #7237)
  * profiles: browsers: add private-cache to firefox-common and chromium-common
    browsers (d3bf6ac, 70107ef)
  * profiles: keepassxc & thunderbird: allow librewolf paths (#7272)
  * profiles: keepassxc-proxy: fix typo (#7278)
  * profiles: evince: add deterministic-shutdown (#7269 #7277)
  * profiles: blink-common-hardened: drop netlink & add mdwe comment (#7165)
  * profiles: torbrowser-launcher: add getconf to private-bin (#7152)
  * profiles: firefox-common: allow `ioprio_set` syscall (#7284)
  * profiles: steam: allow `mount_setattr` syscall (#7268 #7287)
  * new profile: gemini (#6936)
  * new profile: opencode (#7135)
  * new profile: pi (#7136)
  * new profile: ephoto (#7153)
  * new profile: tldr (#7166)
  * new profile: claude (#7169)
  * new profile: tasks-org (#7273)
  * new profile: ChiPass (#7271)
  * new profile: maki (#7285)
